newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia sells 8.5 pct of UES at auction.
newsitem.headline: Russia sells 8.5 pct of UES at auction.

text.p: Russia has sold 8.49 percent of RAO Unified Energy System at auction for 512.82 roubles (9 cents) per shares, after a starting price of 500 roubles per share, the Federal Securities Corporation said on Wednesday.
It also said there had been a two for one stock split after the auction.

The Federal Securities Corporation said in a release that 99.8 percent of the 3.6 billion shares at offer in the auction, where bids were accepted from November 22 to December 23, had been sold to 115 bidders.
It did not name any of the buyers of the company.
UES is a national power company which owns the national power grid.

At 0820 GMT UES shares on the Russian Trading System had firmed to $0.1290 from $0.1270 at Tuesday's close. They have risen sharply in recent weeks, largely on anticipation of auction results. ($ = 5603 Russian Roubles)
